comparison.objective: Candidate tunes and locks a compact industrial damper; pr-1805 secures a bicycle wheel to a stand with a two-part U-lock.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate combines hex-key insertion, body counterhold, fine collar rotation, bounded retightening, and test cycling. pr-1805 threads a rigid shackle through spokes and around a stand, then aligns and pushes a crossbar onto both legs simultaneously.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two safe impacts and post-lock setting retention. pr-1805 requires the closed lock to encircle both rim and stand, both shackle ends inserted at least 16 mm within 4 mm of socket axes, followed by release and 1 s stillness.
comparison.reason: Both include a locking step, but the candidate locks an adjusted scalar setting and evaluates dynamic response; pr-1805 tests constrained threading and simultaneous two-socket assembly around fixed objects. Candidate response and retention tolerances remain partly undeclared.
